# Supplerende graf med åben kirurgi over tid på regionalt niveau

**Supplerende graf med åben kirurgi over tid på regionalt niveau** (Supplementary graph of open surgery over time at the regional level) is a specific visual analysis element introduced in the final publication of the Danish Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen), released by the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) on February 28, 2025 [^src1]. It is the only explicit analysis element and the sole new visual analysis mentioned on page 81 of the report [^src1]. 

The graph is designed to illustrate the temporal development of open surgical procedures across different regions in Denmark, serving as an analytical extension to the preceding quantitative tables [^src1]. Along with other visualizations in the report detailing age distributions and the split between open and minimally invasive (closed) surgeries from 2021 to 2024, this element functions as a quality measure and benchmarking tool to support clinical and political decision-making regarding surgical practices [^src1]. However, while the text introduces the graph on page 81, the actual visual graphic and its underlying data are not included in the extracted text of this section [^src1].
